_about: Ranfurlie tank-mix product library. One record per product, read off the current AU label / maker SDS. {amt} in 'how' is replaced with the tank amount. 'why' is the default reason for its place in the order; a recipe can override it. PPE keys: overalls, hat, gloves, goggles, shield, mask, apron, boots. Checked 14-15 Oct 2026.

companion.name: Companion
companion.what: Acidifying and penetrating surfactant (soya phospholipids + propionic acid)
companion.hazFull: Will damage eyes. Will irritate the skin. Avoid contact with eyes and skin. Label: DO NOT use with copper products.
companion.why: The label says Companion goes in first, before the other products. It holds the tank pH down for the ethephon.

chlorostick.name: Chlorostick 720 SC
chlorostick.haz: Attacks eyes and skin. Don't breathe the mist.
chlorostick.hazFull: Attacks eyes and skin. Don't inhale spray mist. Repeated exposure may cause allergies. If clothing gets product or spray on it, take it off straight away. Label: DO NOT mix spraying oils or wetting agents with this product.
how: Shake and turn each drum over
Rinse each drum 3 times into the tank
chlorostick.why: A suspension goes in early so it spreads through plenty of moving water.
chlorostick.src: Label APVMA 69652 · SDS Feb 2025 · label · SDS

shadow.name: Shadow Ultra
shadow.hazFull: Harmful if inhaled (SDS). Avoid contact with eyes and skin. Don't breathe spray mist. No rain or irrigation within 1 h of spraying. No entry without protective clothing until the spray has dried.
how: Rinse the jug into the tank
shadow.why: The label says add it to a tank at least two-thirds full of water. You're at {before} L.

promote.name: Promote Plus 900
promote.hazFull: Corrosive (SDS: causes severe skin burns and eye damage). Splash in the eye: flush with water for at least 15 minutes and get medical help. Don't use alkaline water. Don't let the mix stand in metal for more than 2 hours. No rain expected within 8 hours.
how: Pour slowly, low to the opening
Rinse the jug and drums into the tank
promote.why: Goes in after Companion so it lands in acidified water. The label says don't use alkaline water.
promote.src: Label APVMA 69487 · SDS ADAMA Jun 2023 · label · SDS

astron.name: ASTRON
astron.what: Floratine foliar biostimulant (Ca, Mg, Fe, Zn, Cu, B)
astron.hazFull: SDS signal word DANGER: causes serious eye damage, causes skin irritation. Contains a copper salt (0.15% Cu). Chemical goggles and impervious gloves.
astron.why: Floratine's mixing order is ASTRON, then Perk Up, then GlycoFuze. It's high in solids, so the strainer comes out.
astron.src: Floratine info sheet + SDS Apr 2024 · SDS

perkup.name: Perk Up
perkup.hazFull: SDS signal word DANGER: causes serious eye damage. Chemical goggles; impervious gloves for long contact.
perkup.why: Floratine's order puts Perk Up before GlycoFuze.
perkup.src: Floratine info sheet + SDS Apr 2024 · SDS

glyco.name: GlycoFuze 2-1-2
glyco.hazFull: Not classified as hazardous (SDS). Goggles and gloves if handling for long.
glyco.why: Last of the Floratine products, by their order.
glyco.src: Floratine info sheet + SDS Apr 2024 · SDS

iron.name: Grass Roots Iron
iron.what: Oasis Turf liquid iron, 6% Fe, pH about 2
iron.hazFull: SDS signal word WARNING: eye irritation. Safety glasses, PVC gloves, overalls, apron and safety boots; eyewash nearby. Label rate 10-20 L/ha.
iron.why: Big volume and no mixing restrictions on its label, so it goes in late.
iron.src: Label + SDS May 2025 (Oasis Turf) · label · SDS

prokelp.name: Pro Kelp
prokelp.what: Grass Roots Pro Kelp 25: Tasmanian bull kelp extracted with caustic potash, pH 10-12.5
prokelp.haz: Strongly alkaline. Keep it apart from the iron and GreenMaxx neat.
prokelp.hazFull: Not classified as hazardous (SDS Nov 2025). pH above 10, contains potassium hydroxide under 5%. Impervious gloves, safety glasses with side shields, cotton overalls; apron for large volumes. Label: 20-50 L/ha in 700 L water/ha; check compatibility before tank mixing.
how: Rinse the drums into the tank
prokelp.why: It's strongly alkaline. Going in early, into plain water, means it never meets the acidic products neat.
prokelp.src: Oasis Turf label + SDS Nov 2025 · label · SDS

greenmaxx.name: GreenMaxx 20-0-0
greenmaxx.what: LiquiMaxx GreenMaxx: stabilised urea N 20%, with 6% Fe and 1% Mg as sulphates, pH 2-3
greenmaxx.hazFull: SDS signal word WARNING: harmful if swallowed, skin and eye irritant, may irritate airways. PVC gloves, overalls and apron, safety glasses or goggles; eyewash nearby. Strong bases listed as incompatible. May settle in the IBC, so stir before drawing. Label rate 20-50 L/ha.
greenmaxx.why: Acidic, like the iron. Goes in late with the other fertiliser.
greenmaxx.src: SDS Dec 2024 (Indigo / Greenway) · SDS · brochure

evoadv.name: Evolution Advance
evoadv.hazFull: Harmful if swallowed. May irritate the eyes. Avoid contact with eyes. Label PPE: cotton overalls buttoned to the neck and wrist when opening, mixing and spraying. Don't apply if rain is expected within 48 h. Wind 3–20 km/h, medium droplets or coarser.
how: Pour into moving water, agitator on
Rinse the drum 3 times into the tank
evoadv.why: A suspension concentrate goes in before the EC and the wetting agent so it disperses properly. You're at {before} L.

zeemil.name: Zeemil 250 EC
zeemil.what: Fungicide: metalaxyl 250 g/L (Group 4) for Pythium. Off-label on turf
zeemil.haz: Irritates eyes and skin. Don't breathe the solvent vapour.
zeemil.hazFull: Label: avoid contact with eyes and skin. Do not inhale spray mist. Beware of solvent vapours when handling the concentrate and near an open spray tank. Registered for pineapples only (2 L/ha).
how: Pour straight in and mix well
Stand upwind of the open lid
Rinse the drum 3 times into the tank
zeemil.why: An EC goes in after the suspension so it doesn't stop it dispersing. You're at {before} L.

terreplex.name: Terreplex
terreplex.haz: Low pH. Irritates eyes and skin.
terreplex.hazFull: Eye and skin irritant. Harmful if swallowed. Wear eye protection, gloves and appropriate clothing. Don't mix with high-pH products unless the tank goes out straight away.
how: Pour into moving water, agitator on
Rinse the drum 3 times into the tank
terreplex.why: An acidifier, so it goes in early with the Companion and conditions the water before the fungicides. You're at {before} L.

hydroforce.name: HydroForce Ultra
hydroforce.what: Wetting agent: carries the fungicides into the thatch and root zone
hydroforce.hazFull: No hazard statements on the tech sheet. Can foam: add slowly. Irrigate after application to move it into the root zone.
how: Pour in slowly, agitator on. It can foam
Rinse the drum 3 times into the tank
hydroforce.why: Wetting agents go in last so they don't foam the tank or coat the other products. You're at {before} L.
hydroforce.src: Indigo tech sheet · tech sheet

quinstar.name: Quinstar 200 SC
quinstar.what: Herbicide: quinclorac 200 g/L (summer grass, white clover, kikuyu suppression)
quinstar.hazFull: Schedule 5. Label rate 4.1 L/ha in 400 L water. Tolerant turf: common and seeded couch, zoysia, Kentucky bluegrass, perennial ryegrass, bentgrass (with a caution). Not tolerant: Qld blue couch, buffalo, kikuyu (suppressed). Tall fescue isn't listed. Kikuyu suppression is 2 applications 14–21 days apart, autumn best. Don't mow 2 days before or after. Avoid rain within 48 h and irrigation within 8 h.
how: Pour into moving water, agitator on
Rinse the drum 3 times into the tank
quinstar.why: A suspension concentrate goes in first after Companion, so it disperses before the oils and salts. You're at {before} L.
quinstar.src: ADAMA Quinstar product guide · guide

firepower.name: Firepower 900
firepower.what: Grass herbicide: haloxyfop-R methyl ester 900 g/L (Group 1)
firepower.haz: Harmful if swallowed. Irritates eyes and skin. Kills bent, couch, kikuyu and most grasses.
firepower.hazFull: Schedule 6. Harmful if swallowed, very toxic to aquatic life. SDS PPE: impervious elbow-length gloves, protective clothing and eye or face protection. Registered for forestry and industrial grass control, not turf. Kills green couch, Qld blue couch, zoysia, buffalo, kikuyu and paspalum.
how: Rinse the measure and drum 3 times into the tank
firepower.why: An EC goes in after the suspension concentrate and before the soluble hormone herbicides. You're at {before} L.
firepower.src: ADAMA SDS · SDS · tech note

fusilade.name: Fusilade Forte
fusilade.haz: Poison. Kills bent, couch, kikuyu and ryegrass. Face shield and elbow gloves.
fusilade.hazFull: Label signal POISON (APVMA 58521). Label PPE when mixing and spraying: elbow-length PVC gloves and a face shield. Registered for horticulture, ornamentals and plantations, not turf. Controls couch, kikuyu, paspalum and ryegrass; Poa and silver grass aren't controlled. Rainfast in 1 hour. Label: DO NOT tank mix with other pesticides without prior reference to Syngenta. No adjuvant needed.
how: Rinse the drum 3 times into the tank
fusilade.why: The second EC, before the soluble hormone herbicides. You're at {before} L.

sportsground.name: Sportsground
sportsground.what: Broadleaf herbicide: mecoprop 336 + dicamba 40 g/L + a third phenoxy (Campbell three-way, Group 4)
sportsground.haz: Poison. Respirator, goggles and elbow gloves when mixing.
sportsground.hazFull: Campbell Sportsground Herbicide, APVMA 31538. The registered label wasn't readable online; the retailer lists mecoprop 336, MCPA 80 and dicamba 40 g/L, and avoid Qld blue couch, carpet grass, kikuyu and centipede. PPE here follows the Campbell Tri-Kombi label (same three-way family). Label PPE (Tri-Kombi): opening and mixing, waterproof protective clothing, washable hat, elbow-length chemical-resistant gloves, impervious footwear, goggles and a half-face respirator with organic vapour cartridges. Hand-held spraying: chemical-resistant clothing buttoned at neck and wrist, washable hat, elbow-length gloves and the half-face respirator.
how: Rinse the drum 3 times into the tank
sportsground.why: Soluble amine salts go in after the ECs. You're at {before} L.

trikombi.name: Methar Tri-Kombi
trikombi.haz: Poison. Respirator, goggles and elbow gloves when mixing and spraying by hand.
trikombi.hazFull: Campbell Methar Tri-Kombi, APVMA 31536. Turf rate 4.2 L in 450 L water per ha (label maximum). Don't use on buffalo. Wind 3–20 km/h, no surface inversions. Don't mow 2 days before or after. No heavy rain or storms within 3 days. Don't irrigate to run-off for 3 days. Not by backpack sprayer. Label PPE (Tri-Kombi): opening and mixing, waterproof protective clothing, washable hat, elbow-length chemical-resistant gloves, impervious footwear, goggles and a half-face respirator with organic vapour cartridges. Hand-held spraying: chemical-resistant clothing buttoned at neck and wrist, washable hat, elbow-length gloves and the half-face respirator.
how: Rinse the drum 3 times into the tank
trikombi.why: The second amine-salt hormone, after the ECs. You're at {before} L.

ecodye.name: Ecodye Blue
ecodye.what: Blue marker dye so you can see where you've sprayed
ecodye.hazFull: Marker dye, not a pesticide. Stains skin, clothing and hard surfaces: keep it off paths and carts.
ecodye.why: Dye before the oil adjuvant, which goes in last. You're at {before} L.

hasten.name: Hasten
hasten.hazFull: Vicchem Hasten. May irritate the eyes and skin; wear protective clothing. Label: add Hasten last and keep agitating until spraying is finished. General rate 0.5–1.0 L/ha, not under 0.2 L/ha.
how: Pour in last, agitator on until it's sprayed out
hasten.why: Hasten's label says it goes in last. You're at {before} L.

poachek.name: Poachek
poachek.what: Endothal 175 g/L (dipotassium salt): Poa annua control in turf. Colin Campbell (Chemicals)
poachek.haz: Fatal if breathed in. Harmful on skin.
poachek.hazFull: Schedule 6 POISON. Fatal if inhaled: wear respiratory protection, elbow-length PVC gloves and a face shield or goggles. Label rate 1.5 L/ha (150 mL per 1000 m2) as a fine spray in 500-1000 L/ha. Don't spray above 25 °C. Apply to dry turf and keep it dry for 24 h after. Not on kikuyu or red fescue.
how: Mist mask and face shield on before you open it
Rinse the jug into the tank
poachek.why: Mixes readily with water. Goes in after the fertilisers, as on the sheet. You're at {before} L.
poachek.src: Label APVMA 47841 · SDS Campbell Dec 2016 · label · SDS

phozfight.name: Phoz Fight 0-22-32
phozfight.what: Oasis Turf Grass Roots potassium phosphite (mono/di-potassium phosphite): 22% P as phosphite, 32% K, pH 6.6-7.2
phozfight.hazFull: Non-dangerous goods. SDS: keep away from strong acids. Label rate 5-10 L/ha in 700 L water every 14-28 days. Check compatibility before tank mixing.
how: Watch the tank: if it goes cloudy or sludgy, stop and call Andy
phozfight.why: Near neutral and its SDS says keep it from strong acids, so it goes in last, into a well-diluted tank after the iron and GreenMaxx. You're at {before} L.
phozfight.src: Oasis Turf Grass Roots label + SDS

ironsulphate.name: Iron Sulphate
ironsulphate.what: Ferrous sulphate heptahydrate, about 20% Fe. Strongly acidic in solution (pH about 2)
ironsulphate.haz: Dust irritates eyes. Rust-stains concrete, metal and clothes.
ironsulphate.hazFull: SDS: not classified as hazardous, harmful if swallowed. Glasses or goggles, elbow-length impervious gloves and face protection when handling, dust mask if it's dusty. pH about 2 (1% solution). Keep away from alkalis, carbonates and oxidisers. Dissolves to 360 g/L at 25 °C. Stains concrete, paths, paintwork and clothing.
how: Add {amt} slowly, a bag at a time
Let each bag dissolve before the next. No lumps left on the strainer
Hose any spilt crystals off concrete straight away: it stains
ironsulphate.why: Goes in once the Companion is through, into a tank two-thirds full so it dissolves properly. You're at {before} L.

regulate.name: Proforce Regulate
regulate.haz: Avoid eye and skin contact. Don't breathe spray mist.
regulate.hazFull: Label: CAUTION. Protective gloves and eye or face protection, don't breathe spray mist. Growth regulation 0.5–2 L/ha in 400–800 L/ha (Poa suppression 2.0–2.8 L/ha). Water in immediately with 4–6 mm of sprinkler irrigation. No DMI (sterol inhibitor) fungicides within 7 days. Not above 32 °C, or on stressed, waterlogged, thinned or freshly cored or scarified turf. Don't scarify or topdress greens while the Poa is being regulated. No re-entry until dry.
how: Rinse the jug into the tank
regulate.why: A suspension: goes in last, into the mixed tank, so it stays spread through it. You're at {before} L.
regulate.src: Label APVMA 88674/121954 · label · tech sheet
